name: so101_vial_to_rack_mujoco_v0
description: MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 vial-to-rack benchmark with fixed vial and slot eval cases.
notes: Requires MuJoCo Menagerie robotstudio_so101/so101.xml from AUTORESEARCH_SO101_MJCF, MUJOCO_MENAGERIE_PATH, or .external/mujoco_menagerie and fails closed if the real RobotStudio/Menagerie model is missing.
The achieved goal is the vial center suspended in the rack slot; success requires center tolerance, uprightness, and rack-height tolerance.

Dense reward shaping follows the SO101-Nexus v0.3.12 PickAndPlaceEnv/RewardConfig structure: reach progress, grasp signal, grasp-gated placement progress, and completion bonus. Credit: https://pypi.org/project/so101-nexus-mujoco/
